h1: Testimonials | Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction

intro.html: At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we believe the best measure of our work is the feedback from the people we’ve helped. Our testimonials reflect the trust homeowners across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and beyond place in us for bespoke carpenter and construction projects of all sizes.

From bespoke media walls and kitchen fitting to full garage conversions and house extensions, single storey extensions, double storey extensions, wrap around extensions, extension builder, timber framed extensions, we’ve had the privilege of working on a wide range of projects. Customers consistently praise our attention to detail, reliability and friendly approach.

As a small, family-run company, reputation means everything to us. That’s why every project, no matter how big or small, is delivered with the same level of care. We’re proud to share the words of satisfied customers who recommend us for our local carpenter craftsmanship and trustworthy service.
Take a look at our gallery to see some of our completed projects, then get in touch to discuss how we can help with your home.

blocks.html: Looking for a local carpenter and building firm in Suffolk or Cambridgeshire? Contact us Gary J Potter on 07415 216223 or email info@garyjpottercarpentry.co.uk.
We carry out all aspects of carpentry and construction, from bespoke projects to full extensions and conversions.
Take a look at our areas we cover, explore our gallery and see what others are saying in our testimonials, then let’s talk about bringing your ideas to life.
